description: This file defines the API and data structures for a string buffer utility (`strbuf`). It includes function declarations for initializing, manipulating, and releasing string buffers, as well as functions for encoding, path normalization, and line-based I/O operations. The file also declares associated data structures and macros related to string buffer management.

classes.name: strbuf
classes.description: Represents a dynamic string buffer with defined capacity (`alloc`), current length (`len`), and a pointer to the character data (`buf`). It maintains invariants such as NUL-termination and non-NULL `buf` for safety in string operations.

methods.name: strbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes a strbuf structure, optionally allocating memory based on the specified size so that further reallocations can be minimized.

methods.name: strbuf_release
methods.description: Releases the memory used by the strbuf and resets it to an empty, safe state.

methods.name: strbuf_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal string buffer from the strbuf structure, transferring ownership to the caller which is then responsible for freeing it.

methods.name: strbuf_attach
methods.description: Attaches an externally allocated string to the strbuf, taking ownership of the memory.

methods.name: void strbuf_swap(struct strbuf * a,struct strbuf * b)
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two strbuf instances.

methods.name: size_t strbuf_avail(const struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Returns the amount of unused allocated space in the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_grow
methods.description: Ensures the buffer has at least the specified additional capacity, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: void strbuf_setlen(struct strbuf * sb,size_t len)
methods.description: Sets the current length of the buffer, updating the NUL-terminator accordingly.

methods.name: strbuf_reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer to an empty state without freeing memory.

methods.name: strbuf_trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from beginning and end of the buffer's contents.

methods.name: strbuf_rtrim
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace.

methods.name: strbuf_ltrim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace.

methods.name: strbuf_trim_trailing_dir_sep
methods.description: Removes trailing directory separators.

methods.name: strbuf_trim_trailing_newline
methods.description: Removes trailing newline characters.

methods.name: strbuf_reencode
methods.description: Reencodes the contents of the buffer from one character encoding to another.

methods.name: strbuf_tolower
methods.description: Converts all characters in the buffer to lowercase.

methods.name: strbuf_cmp
methods.description: Compares two strbufs lexicographically.

methods.name: void strbuf_addch(struct strbuf * sb,int c)
methods.description: Adds a single character to the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_addchars
methods.description: Adds multiple repetitions of a character.

methods.name: strbuf_insert
methods.description: Inserts data at a specified position within the buffer.

methods.name: void strbuf_insertstr(struct strbuf * sb,size_t pos,const char * s)
methods.description: Inserts a null-terminated string at a specified position.

methods.name: strbuf_vinsertf
methods.description: Inserts formatted data at a position, using a va_list.

methods.name: strbuf_insertf
methods.description: Inserts formatted data at a position, using printf-style arguments.

methods.name: strbuf_remove
methods.description: Removes a section of data from the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_splice
methods.description: Replaces a section of the buffer with new data.

methods.name: strbuf_add_commented_lines
methods.description: Adds lines to the buffer, each prepended with a comment prefix.

methods.name: strbuf_add
methods.description: Appends raw data to the buffer.

methods.name: void strbuf_addstr(struct strbuf * sb,const char * s)
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string.

methods.name: strbuf_addstrings
methods.description: Appends a string multiple times.

methods.name: strbuf_addbuf
methods.description: Appends the contents of another strbuf.

methods.name: strbuf_join_argv
methods.description: Joins command-line arguments into the buffer separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: strbuf_expand_literal
methods.description: Expands escape sequences like %n and %x in placeholders.

methods.name: strbuf_expand_step
methods.description: Processes string expansions, recognizing placeholders.

methods.name: strbuf_expand_bad_format
methods.description: Reports unrecognized placeholders in expansions.

methods.name: strbuf_addbuf_percentquote
methods.description: Quotes percent signs in the source buffer and appends to the destination.

methods.name: strbuf_add_percentencode
methods.description: Percent-encodes characters for URL components.

methods.name: strbuf_humanise_bytes
methods.description: Formats byte counts into human-readable strings.

methods.name: strbuf_humanise_rate
methods.description: Formats byte rates into human-readable strings.

methods.name: strbuf_addf
methods.description: Appends formatted text using printf syntax.

methods.name: strbuf_commented_addf
methods.description: Appends formatted text with a comment prefix, prepended with a blank.

methods.name: strbuf_addbuf_percentquote
methods.description: Quotes percent signs in the source buffer, appending to destination.

methods.name: strbuf_addstr_xml_quoted
methods.description: Adds a string with XML special characters escaped.

methods.name: void strbuf_complete(struct strbuf * sb,char term)
methods.description: Ensures the buffer ends with a specific character, appending if necessary.

methods.name: void strbuf_complete_line(struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Ensures the buffer ends with a newline.

methods.name: strbuf_addstr_urlencode
methods.description: URL-encodes a string and appends it.

methods.name: printf_ln
methods.description: Prints formatted output with newline to stdout.

methods.name: fprintf_ln
methods.description: Prints formatted output with newline to a file.

methods.name: xstrdup_tolower
methods.description: Duplicates a string and converts it to lowercase.

methods.name: xstrdup_toupper
methods.description: Duplicates a string and converts it to uppercase.

methods.name: xstrvfmt
methods.description: Creates a formatted string from a format string and va_list.

methods.name: xstrfmt
methods.description: Creates a formatted string from printf-style arguments.

methods.description: Parses optional arguments from a string with default value handling.
